description: Read-only code reviews, design reviews and analyses by another agent family through Cowboy managed calls.
guidance: `cowboy review` gets a read-only second opinion on this worktree's change from another agent and prints only its findings (optional focus text on stdin; `--help`). Skip it by default and decide for yourself: use it at most once per task, before reporting, only when a missed bug would be costly and your own checks cannot rule it out (security, permissions, concurrency, persistence or migrations, data deletion, money, large cross-cutting refactors). Never for small, mechanical, docs, test-only or exploratory edits. Fix real findings and mention them briefly; after a `skipped:` line, or if the command is missing, say nothing. If the user asks for a review, run `cowboy review --ask`. Other delegation: `cowboy {{peer_command}} --help`. Never run `codex exec`, `codex review` or `claude -p` yourself; they run hidden from the user.
